purpose: Machine-readable boundaries for the public portfolio front door.

authority.private_coordination_and_unpublished_wor: TRACKER and child repo wave records

pitfall_boundaries.boundary: The front door may summarize and route, but it must not become the complete portfolio source of truth.

front door owns readiness, dependency, snapshot, or backlog state
series pages replace TRACKER portfolio taxonomy

pitfall_boundaries.boundary: Compressed highlights must retain evidence labels and limitation language.
blocked_claims: public reference artifact is official or externally endorsed
transfer test proves child repo maturity without child evidence

pitfall_boundaries.boundary: Public copy must not expose private coordination surfaces.

public copy can publish TRACKER-only queues
public copy can expose unpublished implementation history
public copy can rely on unexplained agent workflow terms
